sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Jagged Peaks, Savanna Plateau, Stony Peaks, Windswept Gravelly Hills, Windswept Hills, and Windswept Savanna.

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Rock moves and flying moves are 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Avalanche, Circle Throw, Eruption, Fairy Wind, Gust, Hyper Voice, Icy Wind, Mountain Gale, Ominous Wind, Razor Wind, Silver Wind, Storm Throw, Thunder, Twister, and Vital Throw: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Rock-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Bounce and Fly change the field into Sky.
Blizzard, Glaciate, Mountain Gale, and Subzero Slammer change the field into Snowy Mountain.
Eruption, Inferno Overdrive, and Lava Plume change the field into Volcanic Top.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Rocky Payload: 2× power for Rock-type moves.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
